title: Test plan block of a testing work-order
description: The ## Test plan section of a type:test ticket, as parsed by the work-order skill's wo_test_plan_json. The architect writes it from claude/workflow/templates/test-plan.md; the tester runs exactly these cases, in Podman, on the pinned image. Small scope, small tests: full integration is CI's and is named in out_of_scope rather than run here.

scope.description: The one unit the ticket changed, in one line.

intent.description: Why the case matters: what breaks, and for whom, if it fails.

command.description: The exact command, run inside the isolation.

expected.description: The exit code and the observable result.

image.description: A registry image pinned by digest (dotfiles Rule 15), or a locally built localhost/<name>:<tag> with build and containerfile (RR-orch-18: a localhost digest is never used).

build.description: The command that builds the local image tag.

containerfile.description: Project-relative path of the Containerfile; every FROM in it is digest-pinned.

out_of_scope.description: What full integration CI covers instead, so the plan stays small.
